name: Groupe Socialiste – المعارضة الاتحادية (USFP)
detail: In PLF 2026 debates, proposed an amendment targeting exclusively real estate property exceeding 5 million DH at 0.5%–1%; property and real-estate wealth taxes are excluded under Section 2.

name: Gouvernement du Maroc (Ministère de l'Économie et des Finances)
detail: Consistently rejects parliamentary wealth tax amendments across budget debates, citing potential capital flight, investor deterrence, and valuation difficulties; focuses on income tax reform and fighting tax fraud.

name: ATTAC Maroc
detail: Advocacy focuses on cancellation of sovereign debt, critique of neoliberal policies, and financial transaction taxes (Tobin tax); does not campaign for a domestic net wealth tax.

name: Union Marocaine du Travail (UMT)
detail: Major trade union confederation; fiscal advocacy concentrates on personal income tax (IR) relief, raising tax-free allowances for workers, and purchasing power; no specific wealth tax motion found.

name: Younes Chebihi
detail: Economist (Alliance des Economistes Istiqlaliens); argued against introducing an ISF in Morocco in L'Opinion interview, citing OECD repeals and risk of capital flight.

name: Mustapha Chennaoui
detail: Former FGD deputy who co-sponsored parliamentary work with Omar Balafrej; no individual signed quote or distinct statement on wealth taxation found on accessible source pages.

name: Mehdi Lahlou
detail: Economist advocating for inheritance taxation and luxury consumption taxes on external signs of wealth (yachts, luxury cars) rather than an annual net wealth tax.

name: Salah Eddin Mezouar
detail: Minister of Economy and Finance formally denying and rejecting wealth tax discussions in government preparatory meetings for the 2012 Finance Bill.

name: Khalid Hariry
detail: USFP Député who opposed early wealth tax initiatives as poorly designed populist measures lacking political mandate.

name: Lahcen Daoudi
detail: PJD Deputy Secretary General who criticized wealth tax debate as an unrealistic solution difficult to implement in practice.
